newsitem.title: HUNGARY: HUNGARY RADIO NOON HEADLINES - NOV 26.
newsitem.headline: HUNGARY RADIO NOON HEADLINES - NOV 26.

text.p: These are the main headlines on Hungary's Kossuth Radio midday news. Reuters cannot vouch for their accuracy:
- Welfare Minister Gyorgy Szabo has resigned because he could not negotiate enough budget support for the healthcare system.
- Leading Hungarian economists said maintaining the real-term value of all wages and pensions is an unrealistic goal.
- No decision yet on sakcing police chiefs responsible for the worsening of public safety.
- Fate of Hungary's ambassador Antal Annus who was on board of the crashed Ethiopian airliner is still unknown.
- Opposition urges all-party talks on the national news agency draft law.
